Your Program

YOUR 4-SESSION JOURNEY + CONSULTATION

It all starts with a complimentary consultation, followed by 4 structured sessions designed to assess, correct, and build your foundation.

FunctionalFIT Package
$299
Complimentary Consultation + 4 Sessions • Full Assessment • Custom Programming
★

Consultation

Initial Assessment & Goal Setting

  • Discuss your goals using the SMART approach (Specific, Measurable, Attainable, Realistic, and Timely) for both short-term and long-term objectives.
  • Identify any mental and physical obstacles that may impact your training progress.
  • Record your body weight and body fat metrics to establish a clear baseline.
  • Build a strong foundation for your personalized fitness journey.
COMPLIMENTARY Your consultation is complimentary — no commitment required.
01

Session 1

Lower Body Functional Screening

  • Identify current movement patterns and any potential limitations.
  • Conduct a functional screening assessment of the lower body.
  • Perform supporting lower-body breakout assessments as needed (ankle, knee, hip, and Lumbo-Pelvic-Hip Complex).
  • Assign food logging to track nutrition habits and daily intake.
  • Assign one individualized program to complete.
02

Session 2

Corrective Protocol & HIIT Workout

  • Incorporate and assign a daily lower-body corrective protocol based on findings from Session 1.
  • Review Phase 1 of your personalized nutrition plan.
  • Complete a HIIT workout to assess cardiovascular fitness.
  • Assign two individualized programs to complete between sessions.
03

Session 3

Upper Body Screening & Assessments

  • Conduct a functional screening assessment of the upper body.
  • Perform supporting upper-body breakout assessments as needed (shoulder and neck).
  • Assign two individualized programs to complete between sessions.
  • Discuss the projected length of training required to achieve your goals.
  • Provide a customized email outline detailing the recommended training investment and estimated timeframe.
04

Session 4

Programming Foundation & Strength Testing

  • Incorporate and assign a daily upper-body corrective protocol based on findings from Session 3.
  • Break down one new barbell functional movement with proper technique and coaching cues.
  • Work up to a 5-rep max on the functional movement to establish a benchmark.
  • Discuss scheduling options should you choose to continue training.
↻

Between Sessions

After each session, you’ll be assigned tasks—whether corrective exercises, nutrition adjustments, or movement-based activities—to reinforce your training and accelerate progress.

Our Mission

SUSTAINABLE RESULTS THROUGH SMARTER TRAINING

Our mission is to create sustainable results by meeting clients at their point of struggle and building systems that support long-term physical, mental, and emotional well-being.

Unlike generic workout programs, FreddyFit focuses on individualized personal training built around how your body actually moves — not just what exercises you perform.

Whether your goal is weight loss in Saint Louis, strength development, injury prevention, or athletic performance, our approach is designed to support you safely, efficiently, and long term.

Our focus isn’t just on training harder — it’s on training smarter, rebuilding movement quality, and creating a strong foundation for sustainable results.

THE TRANSFORMATION PORTFOLIO

Every transformation starts with a decision. These clients chose to invest in themselves — here are their results.

Laurie's Transformation

Today I’m the strongest and leanest I’ve ever been in my life — 152 lbs, down from 230. But the biggest transformation wasn’t the number on the scale. It was what training built in me that made it last.

Committing to work with a trainer meant stepping way outside my comfort zone. The thought of being in a gym was intimidating — I never thought weight training was something for me. If I lifted anything, it maxed out around 15 lbs for legs, 3–5 lbs for arms. Cardio was where I felt safe.

What made it possible was the environment: a private 24/7 facility available only to clients. Freddy built my program around real assessments, not guesswork, and gave me nutrition guidance that actually fit my life — not just a generic plan.

Eight weeks in, I stepped up onto the retaining wall to reach the patio — something I used to walk all the way around to avoid. These days, walking into that gym feels nothing like it did that first session — it’s just part of my routine now.

Then I deadlifted 185 lbs. I never thought I’d lift anything close to that. I remember being frustrated in a session, convinced I couldn’t finish an exercise, and Freddy just said: “This is why we call it training — just show up and keep working at it.” That stuck with me more than almost anything else.

I started this journey on a GLP-1 in December 2024, and it helped me lose the initial weight. I’ve been off it for almost a year now — a point where I was told many people start regaining — and I haven’t gained back a pound. Strength training is why it stuck.

I can climb stairs without losing my breath, keep up with my family on the pickleball court instead of struggling to move around it, and join outings without feeling winded and tired. I’m no longer classified as obese or pre-diabetic.

I can look at myself in the mirror without the embarrassment I used to carry — the feeling of having let myself get so overweight, not knowing where to even start.

Training is why I kept it off. It’s the best investment I’ve ever made in myself. Worth every penny.

LOWER BODY MASTERY
CERTIFICATION

Tucson, AZ — Advanced Functional Assessment Training

November 2025 • Tucson, Arizona

ADVANCING THE SCIENCE OF MOVEMENT: FREDDY EARNS LOWER BODY MASTERY CERTIFICATION

Freddy earned his Lower Body Mastery certification in Tucson under the expert guidance of Dr. Sean, Brendan, and Jeff. This intensive program took a deep dive into functional assessments, equipping practitioners with the tools to identify the true root causes of pain and movement limitations — starting from the ankle and working up through the entire kinetic chain.

"Assessing the body at every joint is vital for optimal movement. Pain rarely originates where you feel it — the source is often far from the symptom."

The certification featured live case studies that powerfully demonstrated the interconnected nature of the human body. In one session, a participant's neck misalignment was revealed to be the underlying cause of chronic knee pain due to poor alignment and tracking throughout the chain. Another case showed shoulder pain that actually originated from hip misalignment, while a third study uncovered how a twisted pelvis was contributing to weakness and instability in the shoulder.

These real-world demonstrations reinforced a fundamental principle: the body operates as a unified system. Addressing symptoms in isolation often misses the bigger picture. By assessing every joint and understanding how movement compensations cascade through the kinetic chain, practitioners can deliver more effective, lasting results for their clients.

Freddy is now bringing these advanced assessment techniques to all current and future clients — offering a deeper, more comprehensive approach to identifying and resolving pain, improving mobility, and optimizing performance.

KEY CASE STUDY FINDINGS

⛓

Neck → Knee Connection

A cervical misalignment was causing chronic knee pain through poor tracking and compensatory movement patterns down the kinetic chain.

⚛

Hip → Shoulder Link

Shoulder pain traced back to a hip misalignment, demonstrating how lower body dysfunction can manifest as upper body symptoms.

✧

Pelvis → Shoulder Weakness

A twisted pelvis was identified as the root cause of shoulder weakness, proving the importance of full-body kinetic chain assessment.

UPPER BODY MASTERY
CERTIFICATION

Sacramento, CA — 24-Hour Live Immersion

October 2025 • Sacramento, California

UPPER BODY MASTERY: A 24-HOUR LIVE IMMERSION IN ASSESSMENT & CORRECTIVE EXERCISE

A recent three-day, 24-hour live immersion led by Kinesiologist Brandon Fox and Dr. Sean delivered an intensive experience focused on practical case studies and professional development.

During the Upper Body Mastery Certification, participants explored personal injuries and movement limitations while developing structured roadmaps to assess, identify, and modify dysfunctional patterns for long-term restoration. The program emphasized shoulder and neck function, targeting upper body pain and limitations linked to postural discrepancies such as upper crossed syndrome, while isolating and removing unrelated lower body factors.

"Through this process, attendees gained the ability to more accurately trace shoulder pain to its root cause — designing highly personalized prehabilitation and corrective exercise programs aimed at reducing pain and preventing injury caused by chronic imbalances."

Both instructors bring extensive experience working with NFL athletes and former Olympians, offering a high level of expertise throughout the training. Additional thanks were extended to Greg at Varimax Fitness in Sacramento for supporting training needs during the stay.

This certification represents the first in a planned series of three, with Lower Body Mastery and Core Mastery certifications to follow. Completion of the full series will lead to recognition as an Exercise Therapy Personal Trainer through the Exercise Therapy Association. The experience concluded with renewed inspiration, enhanced knowledge, and a comprehensive collection of protocols, assessments, and case studies — further supporting the mission to help clients move pain-free while understanding the root causes of their challenges.

KEY PROGRAM HIGHLIGHTS

⚛

Upper Crossed Syndrome

Targeted postural discrepancies driving shoulder and neck pain, with protocols to isolate and correct dysfunctional upper body movement patterns.

🏆

NFL & Olympian-Level Expertise

Instructors Brandon Fox and Dr. Sean bring real-world experience training elite NFL athletes and former Olympians, raising the caliber of every case study.

✎

Prehab & Corrective Programming

Built structured roadmaps to design personalized prehabilitation programs that address chronic imbalances and prevent future injury at the root cause.

CORE MASTERY
CERTIFICATION

London, England — Advanced Core & Spinal Assessment

April 2026 • London, England

CERTIFIED. REFINED. RECALIBRATED.

Freddy completed his Core Mastery certification through Exercise Therapy Association. This phase sharpened his ability to assess complex dysfunction across the kinetic chain, with emphasis on transverse trunk rotation, spinal alignment patterns, and lumbar segmental dysfunction patterns including compression, retrolisthesis, and spondylitic presentations.

The framework is built on layered functional assessment — each test narrowing contributing variables and directing clinical decision-making toward the primary driver of dysfunction.

"Identify the primary driver, apply a targeted corrective strategy, and implement forward with ongoing reassessment."

Through live case studies in London, UK, Freddy worked with high-complexity presentations involving global compensation across the trunk, pelvis, and shoulder systems. A consistent pattern emerged: local symptoms rarely reflect local causes, with repeated convergence toward the lumbopelvic–hip complex as a primary driver.

One advanced case involved persistent disc-related presentation in a medical professional, requiring integration of mechanical assessment, clinical history, and imaging to map contributing factors and guide intervention strategy.

This marks Freddy's third certification within the system. Each stage continues to sharpen his diagnostic clarity and expand his ability to address multi-segment dysfunction with precision. He will now complete final case study requirements for graduate status and formal recommendation as a Midwest regional pain specialist.

Freddy is grateful for time spent training in London with a high-level cohort of professionals committed to applied clinical reasoning and performance-based care. The standard continues to rise — and so does the expectation he places on his work at FreddyFit.

KEY PROGRAM HIGHLIGHTS

△

Breathing & Intra-Abdominal Pressure

The program explored how diaphragm function and proper breathing mechanics create the pressure needed to stabilize the spine under load and during dynamic movement.

⚙

Deep Stabilizer Sequencing

Freddy developed the ability to assess and restore coordination of the deep core muscles — the foundation of pain-free movement and the missing piece in most traditional training programs.

🏆

Exercise Therapy Personal Trainer

Completing all three certifications (Upper Body, Lower Body, and Core Mastery) earns recognition as an Exercise Therapy Personal Trainer through the Exercise Therapy Association.
